# TRAY — Tray

- Owner: `ticonnect-daemon`
- Stage: 6
- Layer: `clients`
- Component graph: [generated/components/tray.md](generated/components/tray.md)

## Purpose

Own StatusNotifierItem icon, menu, policy actions, activation, and unavailable-tray fallback.

## Boundary

Runs inside the daemon. Calls policy and IPC. Does not own policy state.

## Invariants

- `INV-LIMIT-1` — Every queue, buffer, and frame decoder is bounded or declares its drop policy. Test: planned: design review plus fuzz tests
- `INV-MSG-1` — Message signatures are verified before storage, acknowledgement, or notification. Test: planned: crates/daemon/tests/messaging.rs
- `INV-MSG-2` — Messages are immutable and duplicate records are idempotent. Test: planned: crates/daemon/tests/messaging.rs
- `INV-POL-1` — Ignore policy is enforced before storage; DND suppresses notifications but not storage. Test: planned: crates/daemon/tests/policy.rs
- `INV-SEC-1` — No secret, key, message body, or keystroke is logged by default. Test: planned: logging redaction tests
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check
- `INV-TRUST-1` — No non-pairing feature is reachable before trust is established. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/unpaired_rejected.rs

## Failure semantics

- daemon works without tray
